_about: Bluesky custom feeds served from cultureblocs.com. Each entry becomes an app.bsky.feed.generator record in the publisher's repository (tools/feeds/publish_feeds.py) and is answered by api/xrpc/getFeedSkeleton.js. To add a feed: add an entry, publish, deploy.

feeds.description: Posts from people at Frieze London, Frieze Masters and the week around them (13–18 Oct 2026) — shared from cultureblocs.com/events/frieze-week-london with “I went”, or tagged #CultureBlocs and Frieze. An independent feed, not affiliated with Frieze.

The Offers board from Creative Newham's Creative Spaces Symposium (3 Nov 2026): space, time, skills and kit people in Newham can share. Post with #CreativeNewhamOffer, or from cultureblocs.com/start/creative-newham. Independent of Creative Newham.

The Needs board from Creative Newham's Creative Spaces Symposium (3 Nov 2026): spaces, collaborators, advice and kit people in Newham are looking for. Post with #CreativeNewhamNeed, or from cultureblocs.com/start/creative-newham. Independent of Creative Newham.
